Electrolyte balance is one of the most critical - yet often overlooked - components of a successful and enjoyable ketogenic diet experience.

Simply put, low carb and ketogenic diets strip electrolytes.

Lower carb diets are diuretic in nature, meaning the kidneys shift from retaining water, and sodium, to flushing them. Many will experience increased frequency of urination when switching to a low carb or keto lifestyle,

description:
What is Creapure?

Creapure is a form of creatine monohydrate and is widely considered to be the purest and finest quality creatine monohydrate on the market today. Made by AlzChem in Germany it undergoes a slightly different manufacturing process to make it 'purer', which is one of the reasons it's the preferred creatine for many professional strength, speed, and power athletes.

As a molecule, creatine is an amino acid (broken down protein) derived compound produced in the body that serves as the primary fuel source (ATP) for short duration, high-intensity activities such as sprinting and weight lifting. Creatine is stored primarily in muscle tissue, and it is used for rephosphorylating ADP into ATP. This means that when our muscles use up our energy stores, creatine helps to replenish those stores in a fairly rapid manner. Approximately 2 grams of creatine are found in individuals that do not supplement and maintain a diet including animal-based proteins. Those who do supplement can increase their body’s internal creatine pool by 10 to 40% depending on diet and total lean muscle mass.

What are the benefits?

The ISSN (International Society of Sports Nutrition) found that short-term Creatine Monohydrate supplementation has been reported to improve maximal power/strength (5–15%), work performed during sets of maximal effort muscle contractions (5–15%), single-effort sprint performance (1–5%), and work performed during repetitive sprint performance (5–15%). Long-term creatine monohydrate supplementation appears to enhance the overall quality of training, leading to 5 to 15% greater gains in strength and performance.

description: Once the creatine is stored inside the muscle cell, it attracts the water surrounding the cell thereby enlarging it. In addition, creatine provides for faster recovery in between sets and increased tolerance to high volume work. The way it does this is by enhancing the body's ability to produce Adenosine Triphosphate (ATP). ATP is the compound that your muscles use for fuel whenever they contract. ATP provides its energy by releasing one of its phosphate molecules (it has three phosphate molecules). After the release of such molecule, ATP becomes ADP (Adenosine Diphosphate) as it now only has two molecules. The problem is that after 10 seconds of contraction time the ATP fuel extinguishes and in order to support further muscle contraction glycolisis (glycogen burning) has to kick in. That is fine and well except for the fact that as a byproduct of that mechanism lactic acid is produced. Lactic acid is what causes the burning sensation at the end of the set. When too much lactic acid is produced, your muscle contractions stop, thereby forcing you to stop the set. However, by taking creatine, you can extend the 10 second limit of your ATP system as creatine provides ADP the phosphate molecule that it is missing (recall that creatine is stored in the muscle as creatine phosphate). By upgrading your body's ability of regenerating ATP, you can exercise longer and harder as you will minimize your lactic acid production and you will be able to take your sets to the next level and reduce fatigue levels. description:
Digestive Supplement for Dogs & Cats At Thomas Labs, we understand that digestive issues aren’t fun for anyone, including our pets. That’s why Thomas Pet developed Bio Case, a high potency, pancreatic enzyme capsule for dogs and cats. This digestive supplement for pets has a variety of benefits: Contains high levels of pancreatic enzymes for dogs and cats to assist the pancreas in the breakdown of carbohydrates, proteins, and fats Supports the absorption of nutrients in the digestive system to ensure pets receive the important nutrients from their food Supports pet digestion Helps maintain a healthy intestinal tract Contains beneficial digestive enzymes (amylase, protease, and lipase) to aid digestion, support the immune system, support the skin and coat, and provide energy Supports enzyme replacement needs The Importance of Digestive Enzymes for Dogs & Cats Digestive enzymes play an important role in dogs and cats because they are responsible for breaking down the food that your pet eats. In turn, this makes the nutrients in the food more available for the body to use. Pets receive digestive enzymes in two ways—from their diet and from their bodies as a healthy pet’s pancreas will produce digestive enzymes. However, some pets don’t produce enough digestive enzymes for proper digestion, and many pets eating a processed or cooked diet don’t receive enough digestive enzymes from their food. Aging pets and certain conditions can lead to impaired digestion and decreased enzyme activity. Although rare, some pets have a serious condition in which they cannot make their own digestive enzymes, so they are unable to digest their food and extract necessary nutrition from it. This condition is called Exocrine Pancreatic Insufficiency or EPI in dogs and cats. In these situations, pancreatic enzyme replacement therapy can help replace the digestive enzymes needed for proper digestion and nutrient absorption.

At the same time‚ outer portion of the adrenal gland also releases hormones that cause a rise in blood pressure and blood glucose.

What's in Red Leaf Pre-Workout?
Beta-Alanine for muscle endurance during high-intensity exercise. Glutamine for muscle repair, immune function, and more. Branched Chain Amino Acids (BCAAs) for muscle endurance and repair. Cranberry and Green Tea for antioxidants. Plus a modest dose of pure caffeine for jitter-free focus and energy.

The Power of Beta-Alanine
Beta-Alanine is just one example of the many safe, university-studied ingredients in this pre-workout supplement. A review of various studies by the University of Sau Paulo revealed, "Supplementation with Beta-Alanine has been shown to increase muscle carnosine content and therefore total muscle buffer capacity, with the potential to elicit improvements in physical performance during high-intensity exercise."

The Power of BCAAs, Glutamine, and Arginine
Numerous studies show the benefits of these nutrients to fuel your muscles, which is why they appear in so many preworkout supplements. According to the University of Pavia in Italy, "Data show that BCAA supplementation before and after exercise has beneficial effects for decreasing exercise-induced muscle damage and promoting muscle-protein synthesis."

Plus Green Tea, Cranberry, and Raspberry Ketones
The unique, synergistic blend of ingredients in Red Leaf Pre-Workout is designed to give you nutrition for more intense workouts, vibrant energy, and efficient recovery. Red Leaf is the first pre workout to include cranberry extract, a high ORAC superfood that's packed with antioxidants.

Quality Guaranteed
All products from ISN are formulated and produced in a GMP-certified facility to ensure quality and potency. Proudly made in the USA.

description:
WHAT IS KISS MY KETO CREAMER? Keto Creamer is a keto-friendly MCT Oil Powder that supports a ketogenic or low carb lifestyle. Keto Creamer MCT Powder from Kiss My Keto contains all the essentials your body needs to support your exercise and dieting plan without causing any blood sugar spikes. Keto Creamer is optimal for low-carb energy to align with a low-carb Ketogenic ketone-based lifestyle. WHAT ARE THE BENEFITS OF MCT OIL POWDER? Medium Chain Triglycerides (MCT) are a form of fats that are easily absorbed and used by the body for a source of energy. As a result, MCT can be used for immediate energy to assist your body in reaching a state of ketosis. MCT’s are fast-acting fats for the brain and body and support sustainable energy (no crashes), mental focus (eliminate that brain fog!), and metabolic function. MCT Powder comes from coconut oil and is a high quality fat source for your diet, which is the preferred source of energy in the body. WHAT’S IN KETO CREAMER? Keto Creamer contains MCT Oil Powder (Medium Chain Triglycerides), Inulin (dietary fiber) and sodium caseinate (a milk derivative). There are no nasty fillers, artificial ingredients, binders, or additives that will cause an insulin spike. WHEN SHOULD I USE THIS? Keto creamer can be used at any time in the day. Try adding to your morning drink to feel satiated and focused throughout the day. Add keto creamer to your lunch time meal to keep your body at a sustainable energy level or use it before, during, or after working out for an energy boost. HOW SHOULD I USE THIS? Keto creamer is excellent with coffee, tea, smoothies, and other drinks of choice. No blending is required. Keto creamer is an excellent keto drink. You can also add this to recipes and freshly baked goods.

¿QUÉ ES BESO MI CREMA KETO? Keto Creamer es un polvo de aceite MCT que soporta un estilo de vida cetogénico o bajo en carbohidratos. Keto Creamer MCT Powder de Kiss My Keto contiene todos los elementos esenciales que su cuerpo necesita para apoyar su ejercicio y plan de dieta sin causar ningún pico de azúcar en la sangre. Keto Creamer es óptimo para que la energía baja en carbohidratos se alinee con un estilo de vida de cetonas cetogénicas bajo en carbohidratos. ¿CUÁLES SON LOS BENEFICIOS DEL ACEITE DE MCT? Los triglicéridos de cadena media (MCT) son una forma de grasas que son fácilmente absorbidas y utilizadas por el cuerpo para una fuente de energía. Como resultado, MCT se puede utilizar para la energía inmediata para ayudar a su cuerpo a alcanzar un estado de cetosis. Los MCT son grasas de acción rápida para el cerebro y el cuerpo y apoyan la energía sostenible (sin choques), enfoque mental (elimina esa niebla cerebral! ), y la función metabólica. MCT Powder proviene del aceite de coco y es una fuente de grasa de alta calidad para su dieta, que es la fuente preferida de energía en el cuerpo. ¿Qué hay en la crema Keto? Keto Creamer contiene polvo de aceite MCT (triglicéridos de cadena media), inulina (fibra dietética) y caseinato de sodio (un derivado de la leche). No hay rellenos desagradables, ingredientes artificiales, aglutinantes o aditivos que causen un pico de insulina. ¿Cuándo debo usar esto? La crema Keto se puede usar en cualquier momento del día. Trate de añadir a tu bebida de la mañana para sentirte saciada y concentrada durante todo el día. Agregue crema keto a su comida a la hora del almuerzo para mantener su cuerpo a un nivel de energía sostenible o úselo antes, durante o después de entrenar para un impulso de energía. ¿Cómo debo usar esto? La crema Keto es excelente con café, té, batidos y otras bebidas de elección. No se requiere mezcla. Keto creamer es una excelente bebida keto. También puede agregar esto a recetas y productos recién horneados.

Was ist Kiss My Keto Cremer? Keto Creamer ist ein keto-freundliches MCT-Ölpulver, das einen ketogenen oder Low-Carb-Lebensstil unterstützt. Das Keto Creamer MCT Pulver von Kiss My Keto enthält alle wichtigen Dinge, die Ihr Körper braucht, um Ihren Trainings- und Ernährungsplan zu unterstützen, ohne Blutzuckerspitzen zu verursachen. Keto Creamer ist optimal für Low-Carb-Energie, um sich mit einem kohlenhydratarmen Ketogenen Lebensstil auszurichten. Was sind die Vorteile von MCT Ölpulver? Medium Chain Triglyceride (MCT) sind eine Form von Fetten, die leicht absorbiert und vom Körper als Energiequelle verwendet werden. Dadurch kann MCT sofort Energie verwendet werden, um Ihren Körper bei der Erreichung eines Zustands der Ketose zu unterstützen. MCT sind schnell wirkende Fette für Gehirn und Körper und unterstützen nachhaltige Energie (keine Abstürze), geistige Konzentration (beseitigen Sie den Gehirnnebel! ) und Stoffwechselfunktion. MCT Pulver stammt aus Kokosöl und ist eine hochwertige Fettquelle für Ihre Ernährung, die die bevorzugte Energiequelle im Körper ist. Was ist in Keto-Cremer? Keto Creamer enthält MCT-Ölpulver (mittelkettige Triglyceride), Inulin (Ballaststoffe) und Natriumcaseinat (ein Milchderivat). Es gibt keine hässlichen Füllstoffe, künstliche Inhaltsstoffe, Bindemittel oder Zusatzstoffe, die einen Insulinspieß verursachen. Wann sollte ich das verwenden? Keto Cremer kann jederzeit am Tag verwendet werden. Versuchen Sie, Ihr morgendliches Getränk hinzuzufügen, um sich den ganzen Tag über vollgesättigt und konzentriert zu fühlen. Fügen Sie Keto-Cremer zu Ihrer Mittagszeit hinzu, um Ihren Körper auf einem nachhaltigen Energielevel zu halten oder verwenden Sie ihn vor, während oder nach dem Training für einen Energieschub. Wie sollte ich das verwenden? Der Keto Sahnebereiter eignet sich hervorragend für Kaffee, Tee, Smoothies und andere Getränke Ihrer Wahl. Kein Mischen erforderlich. Keto Cremer ist ein ausgezeichnetes Keto-Getränk. Sie können dies auch zu Rezepten und frischen Backwaren hinzufügen.

מה זה נשיקה את קרם הקטו שלי? קרם Keto הוא אבקת שמן MCT ידידותית לקטו התומכת באורח חיים קטוגני או דל פחמימות. אבקת MCT של Keto Creamer מבית Kiss My Keto מכילה את כל הדברים החיוניים לגוף שלכם כדי לתמוך בפעילות גופנית ובתוכנית הדיאטה שלכם מבלי לגרום לקוצים של סוכר בדם. קרם Keto הוא אופטימלי עבור אנרגיה דלת פחמימות כדי ליישר עם סגנון חיים קטוגני דל פחמימות. מהם היתרונות של אבקת שמן MCT? טריגליצרידים בשרשרת בינונית (MCT) הם סוג של שומנים שנספגים בקלות ומשמשים את הגוף למקור אנרגיה. כתוצאה מכך, MCT יכול לשמש לאנרגיה מיידית כדי לסייע לגוף שלך להגיע למצב של קיטוזיס. MCT's הם שומנים הפועלים במהירות עבור המוח והגוף ותומכים באנרגיה בר קיימא (ללא קריסות), מיקוד מנטלי (לחסל את הערפל המוח! ), ותפקוד מטבולי. אבקת MCT מגיעה משמן קוקוס והיא מקור שומן באיכות גבוהה לתזונה שלכם, שהוא המקור המועדף של אנרגיה בגוף. מה יש בקרם קט? קרם קטו מכיל אבקת שמן MCT (טריגליצרידים בינוניים), אינולין (סיבים תזונתיים) ונתרן קזנט (נגזרת חלב). אין חומרי מילוי מגעילים, מרכיבים מלאכותיים, קלסרים או תוספים שיגרמו יתד אינסולין. מתי כדאי לי להשתמש בזה? ניתן להשתמש בקרם קטו בכל עת ביום. נסו להוסיף למשקה הבוקר שלכם כדי להרגיש שבעים וממוקדים לאורך כל היום. הוסיפו שמנת קטו לארוחה בזמן ארוחת הצהריים שלכם כדי לשמור על הגוף שלכם ברמת אנרגיה בר קיימא או השתמשו בו לפני, במהלך או לאחר אימון להגברת אנרגיה. איך כדאי להשתמש בזה? קרם קטו מעולה עם קפה, תה, שייקים ומשקאות אחרים לבחירה. אין צורך בערבוב. קרם קטו הוא משקה קטו מעולה. אתם יכולים גם להוסיף אותו למתכונים ולאפות טריות.

O que é o creme KISS MY KETO? O creme Keto é um pó de óleo MCT que suporta um estilo de vida cetogênico ou com baixo teor de carboidratos. O creme Keto MCT em pó da Kiss My Keto contém todos os itens essenciais de que o seu corpo precisa para apoiar o seu exercício e plano de dieta sem causar picos de açúcar no sangue. O creme Keto é uma excelente bebida Keto Você também pode adicionar este produto a receitas e produtos recém-assados.

Keto 奶油壶可以在一天中的任何时间使用。 尝试添加到您的早晨饮料中,让一整天都感到舒适和专注。 在午餐时间餐中加入生酮奶精,让您的身体保持可持续能量水平,或在锻炼之前、锻炼期间或之后使用,以提高能量。 我应该如何使用? Keto 奶油壶非常适合搭配咖啡、茶、冰沙和其他饮料。 无需混合。 生酮乳膏是一款出色的生酮饮料。 您也可以将本品添加到食谱和新鲜烘焙食品中。

Keto Comamer 冰棒非常適合搭配咖啡、茶、冰沙和其他飲料。 無需混合。 酮類奶精是一種絕佳的酮類飲料。 您還可以將其添加到食譜和新鮮烘焙食品中。

KISS MY KETO 크리머란 무엇인가요? 케토 크리머는 케토제닉 또는 저탄수화물 라이프 스타일을 지원하는 케토 친화적인 MCT 오일 파우더입니다. Kiss My Keto의 Keto Creamer MCT 파우더는 혈당 스파이크를 일으키지 않고 운동 및 다이어트 계획을 지원하는 데 필요한 모든 필수 요소를 포함하고 있습니다. Keto Creamer는 저탄수화물 에너지가 저탄수화물 케토제닉 케톤 기반 라이프 스타일에 부합하는 데 최적입니다. MCT 오일 파우더의 장점은 무엇입니까? 중쇄 트리글리세라이드(MCT)는 에너지의 원천으로 신체에서 쉽게 흡수되고 사용되는 지방의 한 형태입니다. 결과적으로 MCT는 신체가 케토증 상태에 도달하는 것을 돕기 위해 즉각적인 에너지에 사용할 수 있습니다. Glucosamine occurs in the body, where it helps form "proteoglycans", molecules composed of protein and polysaccharides (complex sugars) that serves as primary structural components of cartilage and other connective tissues. Proteoglycans are essential for maintain the strength and elasticity of cartilage, as well as its ability to function as a shock absorber in joints so that we can move easily and comfortably during activities such as running and jumping. Proteoglycans are also found in the synovial fluid, the viscous, comfort-maintaining fluid that lubricates joints. Glucosamine is a key factor for the body’s ability to maintain the cushioning effect of joint cartilage that is required for normal movement.*

Chondroitin Sulfate is another fundamental structural component of joint cartilage. A complex molecule, chondroitin sulfate is designed by nature, by virtue of its electrochemical make-up, to help cartilage resist compression forces. Chondroitin sulfate has a strong attraction for water which is important for maintaining the normal water content in cartilage that is key to supporting healthy joint structure and function.*

description:
Pure Advantage Creatine Monohydrate is a compound that is naturally made in our bodies to supply energy to our muscles. It is produced in the liver, pancreas and kidneys and is transported to the body's muscle through the blood stream. There is also evidence that creatine can stimulate muscle growth. Pure Advantage Creatine Monohydrate is pure and U.S Pharmaceutical grade. Creatine is formed from the amino acids arginine, methione, and glycine through an involved chemical process. Creatine is created in the liver and may also be produced in the pancreas and kidneys. It is transported in the blood and taken up by muscle cells, where it is converted to creatine phosphate, also called phosphocreatine. This reaction involves the enzyme creatine kinase which helps bond creatine to a high-energy phosphate group. Once the creatine is bound to a phosphate group, it is permanently stored in a cell as phosphocreatine until it is used to produce chemical energy called adenosine triphosphate (ATP). Once this is done, creatine can be released to spontaneously form creatinine, which is then removed from the blood via the kidneys and excreted in the urine. In order to increase athletic performance and boost lean body mass, creatine must be taken in concentrations which are not reasonably obtained from a whole food diet.

Although creatines role in the energy production process is its most notable trait, there is evidence that creatine can stimulate muscle growth. It does this in a couple of different ways. By allowing you to perform more work as a result of additional energy, increased protein synthesis is stimulated. Secondly, when an abundance of creatine phosphate is stored in the muscle, the muscle will hold more water in its cells and become what is known as volumized or super-hydrated. The more volumized a muscle is, it will promote the synthesis of protein as well as deter the breakdown of protein. Volumizing the muscle will also create an environment where an increased level of Glycogen synthesis will take place. Increased protein synthesis along with training will lead to muscle growth. There is also scientific evidence that shows supplementation with creatine causes muscle tears to repair themselves quicker. Here at Nutritional Brands our formulas are never static. As new and proven scientific evidence comes to light, we carefully review our formulas to ensure we continue to offer you the most effective products with maximum bio-availability. For your health, our creatine does not contain egg, starch, sugar, corn, yeast, wheat, soy, milk, gluten, or preservatives. Creatine Monohydrate benefits include helping build lean body mass, which allows greater force to be used, providing energy so duration of exercise or work can be lengthened, speeding recovery so exercise frequency can be increased, promoting muscle growth by stimulating protein synthesis and buffering lactic acid to improve exercise recovery time.

Amplifies Your Athletic Performance
Studies have demonstrated how effective L-Carnitine can be at amplifying your performance in the weight room, on the field, or during a game. Supports the Post-Workout Recovery Process

حمض البانتوثينيك (فيتامين B-5) هو عضو في عائلة فيتامين ب المركبة، وهو موجود في كل خلية حية تقريبًا كمكون من أنزيم الأنزيم A (CoA). يعتبر CoA ضروريًا لتوليد الطاقة من الدهون والكربوهيدرات والبروتين. * كما أنها تلعب دورًا حاسمًا في العديد من التفاعلات التجميلية الحيوية أيضًا، وهي ضرورية لإنتاج الدهون والكوليسترول والناقلات العصبية وخلايا الدم الحمراء وإفرازات الغدة الكظرية. * على هذا النحو، حمض البانتوثينيك ضروري لوظائف خلايا لا حصر لها والحفاظ على الأيض الخلوي الصحي. *

O ácido pantotênico (vitamina B-5) é um membro da família de vitaminas do complexo B e é encontrado em quase todas as células vivas como um componente da coenzima A (CoA). 泛酸(维生素 B-5)是复合维生素 B 族维生素的一员,几乎每个活细胞都被发现,作为辅酶 A (CoA)的组成部分。 CoA 对能量产生至关重要的能量,碳水化合物和蛋白质。 * 它还在许多生物合成反应中起着关键作用,也是脂肪、胆固醇、神经递质、红细胞和肾上腺分泌物的产生所必需的。 * 因此,泛酸对无数细胞功能和维持健康的细胞代谢至关重要。 *

description: Lutein: Important Antioxidant for Eye Health Lutein is a carotenoid found in vegetables and fruits. It is not made in the body and can be obtained only through large amounts of certain fruits and vegetables or through food and vitamin supplements. Products containing lutein are in high demand by consumers who don't have time or don't choose to consume enough lutein in their diets. If you are concerned about the health of your eyes, consider Vitabase Lutein. Lutein is the primary carotenoid found in the macula, the central part of the retina. Lutein has been found in the eyes, serum, skin, cervix, brain, and breast. Within the human eye, lutein deposits itself in the macular region as well as the entire retina, ciliary iris bodies, and lens. While lutein is not a vitamin, it is an antioxidant that may help protect the macula tissue from destructive oxidation reactions by scavenging free radicals. Lutein also filters high-energy blue light that can damage the macula and skin. Support for Macular Degeneration and Cataracts Researchers at Harvard found that eating 6 mg of lutein each day lowered the odds of developing macular degeneration, a leading cause of blindness in the elderly, by 43 percent. According to several studies, loading up on lutein also seems to reduce the likelihood of cataracts by 20 to 50 percent. Further research is necessary, however, before a specific health benefit can be determined. Lutein is found abundantly in green leafy vegetables such as spinach and kale, but few people eat enough of these vegetables to get an adequate intake of lutein. To consume the recommended 6 mg per day, one must eat a large bowl of spinach salad or the equivalent.

What is 2'-Fucosyllactose (oligosaccharide prebiotic)?

2'-Fucosyllactose (2'-FL) is a universal prebiotic product for young and old that is produced by a leading company in Germany. 2'-Fucosyllactose is a unique compound originating in breast milk. The intestinal flora is an important player that influences many aspects of human physiology. Breast milk is by nature the baby’s first food forming the intestinal flora from the ground up, by selectively stimulating the growth of specific bacteria, especially bifidobacteria. The special sugar compounds (oligosaccharides) in breast milk to which 2'-Fucosyllactose belongs play a key role in this important process of microbiome formation.


Oligosaccharide: the unique power of breast milk

More than 100 years ago, it was noted that breastfed infants had better survival chances than infants who received the bottle. After decades of research it turned out that mother's milk contained a special composition that cannot simply be replaced by milk from other animals or man-made milk formulations.

One of the unique aspect of breast milk is that it contains high concentrations of oligosaccharides. The more than 200 oligosaccharides found in breast milk are known as Human Milk Oligossaccharides (HMOs). Sugars are in fact the main components of breast milk, followed by fats and proteins. Breast milk oligosaccharides constitute the third largest solid component of human milk, after lactose and fat.

The oligosaccharides are extremely rare in nature and uniquely found in breast milk when it comes down to composition and concentrations. For example, the high concentrations cannot be found in cow's milk or cow's milk-based infant formulas. Per liter of breast milk, the concentration of oligosaccharides is 5-15 grams, in sharp contrast to 0.05 grams per liter of cow's milk.

description:
The function of the thyroid gland is to take iodine and convert it into the hormones thyroxine, and triiodothyronine. These hormones regulate the rate of oxygen use by cells, and regulate the generation of body heat. The purpose of the thymus gland is to produce and process lymphocytes or T-cells, essential cells in the immune system . The thyroid gland needs iodine to synthesize thyroxine (T4) and tri-iodothyronine (T3), hormones that regulate metabolism and steer growth and development. T4 contains four iodine atoms combined with 27 other atoms of carbon, hydrogen, oxygen, and nitrogen, but owing to its large size accounts for 65 percent of the molecule's weight. T4 (thyroxine) and T3 (triiodothyronine) are important thyroid hormones. Yet, even with normal levels of T3 and T4, it’s possible to still have the symptoms of hypothyroidism, which may be due to excessive production of rT3 in the body. It’s normal for your body to produce some rT3. In fact, the liver constantly converts T4 to rT3 to get rid of excessive amounts of T4. Normally, about 40 percent of T4 is converted to T3 and 60 percent is converted to rT3.

Astaxanthin belongs to the family of carotenoid compounds known as xanthophylls, which includes lutein and zeaxanthin. Astaxanthin is produced by algae, which is consumed by tiny crustaceans such as krill. description:
Carotenoid that Provides Major Protection

Life Blend’s Vision Support is Formulated around the main ingredient, Lutein, known as The Eye Vitamin. Lutein has been shown to support visual function and to protect the health of eye tissues as we age.

The typical western diet doesn't include

Lutein is a carotenoid found in tomatoes, mangos, sweet potatoes, leafy greens, and carrots. The typical western diet doesn't include nearly enough of these fruits and vegetables - so it's likely you have a deficiency in lutein.

Supports age-related eye challenges

Studies have shown that lutein promotes eye and vision help and combat age-related eye challenges. Lutein helps the pigment of your retina which absorbs harmful light - acting as a sort of filter. You were born with a certain amount of lutein in your eyes, but your body does not reproduce it. You must get lutein from your diet and supplementation.

Provide protection against oxidative and free radical damage

One of the primary functions of lutein is to provide protection against oxidative and free radical damage. These yellow-colored carotenoids are found in high concentrations within the macula lutea (the yellow spot in the center of the retina) and in smaller amounts throughout the retina and the eye lens. They are also present in the skin, breast and cervical tissues. These stores, however, appear to diminish with age if not regularly replenished through dietary means.

Protected from light-induced damage

Scientists believe that lutein contribute to the density of macular pigment--the component of the eye which typically absorbs and filters out 40 to 60 percent of damaging near-ultraviolet blue light, which strikes the retina. Lutein also helps limit blue light damage to the inner retina by protecting against lipid peroxidation and by neutralizing free radicals.

description: Gamma Aminobutyric Acid (GABA for short) is possibly the most essential of all of the nutrients deemed nonessential. It is essential for brain functioning, particularly in order to promote feelings of calmness and peace. GABA is classified as an inhibitory neurotransmitter (a substance which allows messages to be communicated at a cellular level within the nervous system) and is found all throughout the brain. It is created from glutamic acid being assisted by vitamin B6. GABA is created from the reaction that takes place between GAD (glutamic acid decarboxylase) and vitamin B6. GABA is essential in triggering the actions of a few different muscles and in maintaining their levels of activity. The body's ability to actually continually produce GABA on its own is somewhat hampered by the fact that B-chain vitamins are required for all of the reactions that take place in order to form and eventually synthesize GABA. Therefore, to keep GABA levels high, make sure to consume foods rich in B chain vitamins, especially ones with high Vitamin B6 content. Foods high in protein are also needed for successful GABA synthesis. The best foods to fulfill these jobs would be fish (mackerel especially) and wheat bran.

Diosmin 750 Vein Health 60 Capsules

There are three varieties of blood vessels:
♦ Arteries.
♦ Veins.
♦ Capillaries.

♦ During blood circulation, the arteries carry blood away from the heart.
♦The capillaries connect the arteries to veins.
♦ Finally, the veins carry the blood back to the heart.
♦If you took all of the blood vessels out of an average person, and laid them out in one line, the line would be around 60,000 miles long!
♦Like almost everything else in our bodies, our veins are susceptible to deterioration with age, especially if we have a poor diet or inadequate exercise.
♦ This is particularly true of the veins in our legs, which have the difficult job of conducting blood upward against gravity’s relentless pull.

What Exactly Are Varicose Veins?

♦ Varicose veins are really just veins that have become enlarged with extra blood.
♦Normally, veins are supposed to act as one-way valves and shouldn’t allow blood to flow back down the legs.
♦ But if a vein becomes weak, blood may flow backwards and collect in the vein, causing it to swell.
♦These swollen veins are either spider or varicose veins.
♦ Spider veins are smaller and are usually red or blue in color.
♦Researchers aren’t sure why some veins become varicose.
♦ Heredity is believed to play a part, as are hormones. That’s one of the reasons varicose veins may be more common in pregnancy.

description: Bile salts are a component of bile secreted from liver cells and derived from the chemical modification of cholesterol. Bile salts enable bile to mix fats with water, electrolytes and other organic molecules present in the bile. Their primary role is to break down fat into smaller, useable molecules. Although bile naturally exists in the body, numerous factors can affect its bioavailability such as diet, gallbladder removal, gastrointestinal conditions, diseases, and aging. In these cases, bile salt supplementation is essential. Reduction of bile acid secretion and bile flow may lead to various gastrointestinal symptoms such as gas and bloating, indigestion, and acid reflux. It may also lead to poor digestion, a deficiency of fat-soluble vitamins, malnutrition, and other health conditions. Bile Salts Booster is designed to boost your body’s own bile. It does this by providing a more water-soluble form of bile salt than most people with compromised gallbladders or bile make on their own. For those who have or had gallstones, their bile tends to be more “lithogenic” or stone-forming. The addition of the amino acid, taurine, is there to support the body’s own conversion to more water-soluble and less toxic bile salts (which is what lithogenic bile is). If your fat digestion is not optimal, you may find Bile Salts Booster to be just the support your bile system needs. Of course, changing your diet to one that favors gallbladder-friendly foods is also helpful. That is particularly important when it comes to fats. Fried foods, fast foods, hydrogenated fats, and saturated fats from meat can cause gallbladder problems and on-going symptoms even after gallbladder removal. Studies report that for people who do not adopt a better diet with healthier and lesser fats following gallbladder surgery will most likely end up with symptoms afterwards, including weight gain. description: Lungwort (Pulmonaria officinalis) is a perennial herb up to 30 cm tall with a thick, well-developed branched rhizome. The stalk is up straight, covered with hard bristly hairs. The leaves are rough, also pubescent, with bright spots. The flowers are located at the ends of the stems, collected in inflorescences - loose curl. Calyx is narrow-bell-shaped, five-lobed, green or bluish. Corolla is with bell-shaped limb; pink or violet-pink at blossoming flowers. After blooming, the flowers turn blue-violet. Pollination occurs with the help of insects, the nectar in the flower is protected from all ineffective pollinators by a long corolla tube. Coltsfoot (Tussilago farfara) is a perennial herbaceous plant 10-25 cm high, with a long thick creeping branched rhizome, covered with scales at the apex. Coltsfoot blooms in early spring in March-April. The stems are up-straight, unbranched, densely planted with scaly brownish-red leaves covered with woolly hairs.The fruits are cylindrical achenes with crest. The fruits ripen in May-June.

description: There are a number of different types of collagen; the most prevalent two in the human body are types I and III. In fact, type I collagen is the most abundant protein in the human body - it is present in almost every type of tissue.1 Bone contains almost exclusively type I collagen. The collagen network in bone confers structural strength to bone tissue and prevents bone fragility. Deficient or defective collagen production, as can occur with aging, is a risk factor for fractures and other bone deformities. Type I collagen is also the major protein found in skin connective tissue where it is responsible for providing skin with its tensile strength and resiliency. Type III collagen is found at high levels in cardiovascular tissue and also in newly developing skin. It is essential for the proper development of the cardiovascular system and skin tissue. Types I and III collagen are often found together in the same tissues, as each form complements the structural integrity of the other. Vitamin C is required for the synthesis of collagen and participates at nearly every step of the process.

description:
Long-chain omega-3 fatty acids (PUFAs) are essential to maintaining a healthy body. Research has demonstrated that omega-3s play a pivotal role in early retinal and brain development, as well as promoting healthy cardiovascular, cognitive and immune system functions. But the typical western diet is inadequate for supplying enough omega-3s (EPA and DHA). Recent studies demonstrate that not all omega-3s are equal.

Of the two primary sources of EPA and DHA; fish provide a triglyceride form, and krill provide a phospholipid form. Studies are showing that the phospholipid form is significantly more bioavailable, with similar plasma EPA and DHA being achieved at much lower omega-3 doses. Most recently, data has emerged indicating that our bodies process the phospholipid form differently than the triglyceride form.

Due to phospholipid uptake into cell membranes, red blood cell uptake and brain uptake are greater, whereas omega-3s from triglyceride forms are more likely to be utilized for energy storage or metabolized as fuel. Additionally, the phospholipid form appears to have more bio-activity. Krill oil, but not fish oil lowered 2-AG levels in over-weight individuals, suggesting krill oil may have a healthy effect on appetite and emotional state. description:
Traditional CoQ10 supplements are made using the oxidized form of CoQ10 known as ubiquinone. Once absorbed, ubiquinone needs to be converted by the body to ubiquinol, the active form of CoQ10.

About 90% of the CoQ10 used by the body is the ubiquinol form. However, the ubiquinone to ubiquinol conversion process involves 17 different steps – and gets progressively more difficult for your body to do efficiently once you’re past the age of 20.

Until recently, ubiquinol wasn’t available for use in supplements because it is easily oxidized (causing it to revert to ubiquinone). That changed with the introduction of a stabilized ubiquinol called Kaneka QH – which is used in TrueCoQ10.

Kaneka QH ubiquinol has been shown to be up to eight times more effective than ubiquinone at raising blood levels of CoQ10.

TrueCoQ10 is also made the CoQH-CF technology which helps in both the absorption and stabilization of the Kaneka QH ubiquinol.

CoQ10 used in supplements tends to crystalize at normal temperatures. These crystals make it very difficult for your body to absorb CoQ10. CoQH-CF eliminates this concern and keeps the ubiquinol fully solubilized – allowing TrueCoQ10 to be readily and quickly absorbed.

A clinical study that combined CoQH-CF and 100mg of Kaneka QH ubiquinol found that it raised blood CoQ10 levels 4.3x on average than regular CoQ10.

As important, CoQH-CF uses alpha lipoic acid and other nutritional compounds to make sure Kaneka QH ubiquinol stays as ubiquinol in the bottle, and doesn’t oxidize.

Together, Kaneka QH ubiquinol and CoQH-CF help maximize the benefits of supplementing with TrueCoQ10.

The calculations for how much CC (cubic centimeters) capacity of oxygen absorbers you need in container and very complex and take into account how much air in the container remains after you fill it with product (seeds, grains, etc...) Use this rule of thumb:

The vast majority of fish oil sold globally; including those sold in North America are Ethl Ester EPA and DHA concentrates. Only a small percentage of fish oil concentrates on the market are natural TGs (triglycerides). Creatine monohydrate is an organic compound that helps facilitate recycling of ATP in muscle and brain tissue and is found in vertebrates. It was first discovered in 1832 by Michel Eugéne Chevreul, and the first evidence of its benefits on the muscles was found in 1912 by Harvard University researchers. Creatine became available as a dietary supplement in 1993, and since then it has become one of the most widely studied supplements. Creatine is commonly taken by athletes and bodybuilders and has become a staple of workout supplements.

Creatine monohydrate may promote anaerobic strength and weight gain and help increase muscle size.* Creatine may also help with cognitive function and support the brain.*

description:
Natto is a traditional Japanese food consisting of soybeans fermented with Bacillus subtilis. Its history traces back over 1,000 years, with over 200,000 tons being consumed in Japan during 2008 alone. As a food, natto is viscous and odiferous in a way that may be expected of a fermented product. Health-wise, there are two important constituents often associated with natto - vitamin K2 (in the form of MK-7), and nattokinase, a fibrin-dissolving enzyme. One of vitamin K’s most prominent roles is assisting with blood-clotting by helping to produce clotting-factors. Nattokinase, however, is involved in the opposite process. This is sometimes the conundrum with natto. In fact, many health practitioners rightly advise patients taking blood-thinning medication to avoid natto due to the vitamin K content. This is despite the support nattokinase may offer in helping balance clot formation and degradation.* Others with soy allergies, or those who simply have a distaste for natto, cannot access the health benefits of natto. Fortunately, Jarrow Formulas NattoMax provides purified nattokinase that is both free-from vitamin K and safe for people with soy allergies.


Distinguishing Features:

  • Prolonged efficacy compared to alternatives
  • Purified enzyme without adulterants
  • Vitamin K free
View larger
Blood Clotting Balance*

The biochemical cascade that leads to blood-clotting, the first step in a wound healing, is both complex and life-preserving. Without it, a minor cut could lead to an untimely demise. At the center of this process is fibrin, a fibrous protein produced by an enzyme, thrombin, which is activated when the body senses clotting is required. Upon healing the fibrin is covered over by normal tissue, while another set of proteins (e. g. plasmin) helps to dissolve the now unnecessary fibrin. This is the normal process at the site of a wound, but as we age, or under certain physiological conditions, the ability to dissolve fibrin tends to fall out of balance with the ability to create fibrin.

When fibrin accumulates in blood vessels, blood begins to flow less freely. This can reduce oxygen transport to heart and brain tissue, resulting in suboptimal function. Meanwhile, the excess fibrin can make blood vessels less pliable and lead to elevated blood pressure. Nattokinase helps to maintain proper blood viscosity, fibrin levels, and healthy circulation, all effects that draw support from research conducted at the National Cardiovascular Center in Japan.*

Nattokinase, Circulation, And Enzyme Digestion

Nattokinase is believed to do a number of things in promoting circulatory health.* First, it acts as a natural fibrinolytic (clot-dissolving) enzyme that helps to support the body’s ability to regulate fibrin.* In fact, this is why nattokinase is measured in terms of fibrinolytic units (FU). And some research suggests that nattokinase is more effective than the body’s own enzyme, plasmin, for this purpose. Second, nattokinase appears to support normal levels of plasminogen activator inhibitor 1 (PAI-1). High levels of PAI-1 can negatively impact fibrin degradation by reducing the plasminogen levels that are critical to the production of plasmin. By maintaining normal levels of PAI-1, nattokinase supports the body’s own fibrin-dissolving mechanisms.*

Ingesting an enzyme raises an interesting question: if an enzyme is merely a protein, won’t it be digested and inactivated in the intestines? There’s little doubt that some of the nattokinase is broken down into smaller protein fragments and amino acids, but it seems that a significant portion is absorbed, fully functional. Yet even more interesting is research suggesting that fragments of nattokinase, generated upon digestion, have circulatory-health activity too. This does not come as a huge surprise since other food-source protein fragments, such as those from sesame and milk , possess biological activity. But what may be less expected is that fragments of nattokinase appear to possess distinct and complementary effects to that of the whole enzyme. For instance, researchers found that nattokinase fragments interacted with angiotensin II, a peptide hormone that helps regulate blood pressure via action on other enzymes such as renin and acetycholineesterase. Whole nattokinase does not do this. This means that the action of digestion on nattokinase may actually be beneficial, not detrimental.

*These statements have not been evaluated by the Food and Drug Administration. This product is not intended to diagnose, treat, cure, or prevent any disease.
